title: Developmental toxicity and estrogenicity of glyphosate in zebrafish in vivo and in silico studies.
authors: Lu, Jian; Zhang, Cheng; Xu, Wenping; Chen, Weidong; Tao, Liming; Li, Zhong; Cheng, Jiagao; Zhang, Yang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究草甘膦对斑马鱼的发育毒性和雌激素效应，涉及分子对接预测其与雌激素受体的结合，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅部分方法可借鉴。
abstract: As the most heavily used herbicide globally, glyphosate (GLY) has been detected in a variety of environments and has raised concerns about its ecological and health effects. There is debate as to whether GLY may disrupt the endocrine system. Here, we investigated the developmental toxicity of GLY in zebrafish based on deep learning-enabled morphometric analysis (DLMA). In addition, the estrogenic activity of GLY was assessed by endocrine disruption prediction, docking study and in vivo experiments. Results showed that exposure to environmental concentrations of GLY negatively impacted zebrafish development, causing yolk edema and pericardial edema. Endocrine disruption prediction suggested that GLY may target estrogen receptors (ER). Molecular docking analysis revealed binding of GLY to three zebrafish ER. In vivo zebrafish experiment, GLY enhanced the protein levels of ERalpha and the mRNA levels of cyp19a, HSD17b1, vtg1, vtg2, esr1, esr2a and esr2b. These results suggest that GLY may act as an endocrine disruptor by targeting ER, which warrants further attention for its potential toxicity to aquatic animals.
abstract_zh: 作为全球使用量最大的除草剂，草甘膦（GLY）已在多种环境中被检测到，并引发了对其生态和健康影响的担忧。关于GLY是否可能干扰内分泌系统存在争议。在此，我们基于深度学习驱动的形态计量分析（DLMA）研究了GLY对斑马鱼的发育毒性。此外，通过内分泌干扰预测、分子对接研究和体内实验评估了GLY的雌激素活性。结果表明，暴露于环境浓度的GLY对斑马鱼发育产生负面影响，导致卵黄囊水肿和心包水肿。内分泌干扰预测提示GLY可能靶向雌激素受体（ER）。分子对接分析显示GLY与三种斑马鱼ER结合。在斑马鱼体内实验中，GLY增强了ERalpha蛋白水平以及cyp19a、HSD17b1、vtg1、vtg2、esr1、esr2a和esr2b的mRNA水平。这些结果表明，GLY可能通过靶向ER作为内分泌干扰物，这值得进一步关注其对水生动物的潜在毒性。
